# WAS_PCR { #wass2s.WAS_PCR }

```python
WAS_PCR(
    regression_model,
    n_modes=None,
    use_coslat=True,
    standardize=False,
    detrend=True,
    opti_explained_variance=None,
    L2norm=False,
    normalize=None,
)
```

Spatial principal-component regression wrapping a WAS regression model.

This class implements a two-stage pipeline:

1. **EOF dimensionality reduction** — the spatial predictor field(s) are
   decomposed into principal components (PCs) by :class:`~wass2s.was_eof.WAS_EOF`,
   which handles NaN filling, optional linear detrending, and optional
   per-field variance normalization entirely within each cross-validation
   fold (no data leakage).
2. **Regression** — the resulting PCs are passed to any compatible WAS
   regression model (e.g. :class:`~wass2s.was_linear_models.WAS_MLR`,
   :class:`~wass2s.was_machine_learning.WAS_RandomForest`, …).

## Single-field and multivariate predictors {.doc-section .doc-section-single-field-and-multivariate-predictors}

``Predictor`` may be a single :class:`xarray.DataArray` *or* a **list** of
DataArrays representing different variables and/or grids (e.g. SST + SLP +
rainfall indices).  A list triggers a **combined multivariate EOF**: each
field is preprocessed and normalized independently on the training fold so
that no single field dominates the joint covariance, then
:class:`~wass2s.was_eof.WAS_EOF` builds one shared set of PCs that feed
the regression.

.. note::
    When using this class inside :class:`~wass2s.was_cross_validate.WAS_Cross_Validator`,
    pass the **raw** predictor (do *not* pre-detrend outside the fold loop).
    For a list predictor, slice every field per fold::

        X_train = [p.isel(T=train_idx) for p in Predictor]
        X_test  = [p.isel(T=test_idx)  for p in Predictor]

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                    | Type         | Description                                                                                                                                                                          | Default    |
|-------------------------|--------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| regression_model        | object       | An instantiated WAS regression model exposing at least ``compute_model(X_train, y_train, X_test, ...)`` and, optionally, ``compute_prob(...)`` and ``forecast(...)``.                | _required_ |
| n_modes                 | int          | Number of EOF modes to retain.  Ignored when ``opti_explained_variance`` is set.                                                                                                     | `None`     |
| use_coslat              | bool         | Apply cosine-latitude area weighting in the EOF decomposition.                                                                                                                       | `True`     |
| standardize             | bool         | Standardize each grid point before the EOF decomposition (useful when the predictor is not expressed as anomalies).                                                                  | `False`    |
| detrend                 | bool         | Remove a linear trend from each grid point before the EOF decomposition.  The trend is estimated on the training fold and applied to the test fold to avoid leakage.                 | `True`     |
| opti_explained_variance | float        | Target cumulative explained variance (%) used to select the optimal number of modes automatically (e.g. ``90.0`` for 90 %).                                                          | `None`     |
| L2norm                  | bool         | Return L2-normalised EOF scores and components from :class:`~wass2s.was_eof.WAS_EOF`.                                                                                                | `False`    |
| normalize               | bool or None | Per-field scalar rescaling so that no field dominates the joint covariance in a multivariate EOF.  ``None`` means *auto*: enabled for a list of fields, disabled for a single field. | `None`     |

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name      | Type                                     | Description                                                                                         |
|-----------|------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| eof_model | :class:`~wass2s.was_eof.WAS_EOF` or None | The fitted EOF object, available after the first call to :meth:`compute_model` or :meth:`forecast`. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

Single-field PCR with a Ridge regression back-end:

```python
>>> from wass2s import WAS_PCR, WAS_Ridge_Model
>>> pcr = WAS_PCR(WAS_Ridge_Model(alpha=1.0), n_modes=10, detrend=True)
>>> result = pcr.compute_model(X_train, y_train, X_test)
```

Multivariate PCR (SST + SLP):

```python
>>> pcr_mv = WAS_PCR(WAS_MLR(), opti_explained_variance=85.0)
>>> result  = pcr_mv.compute_model([sst_train, slp_train], y_train,
...                                 [sst_test,  slp_test])
```

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [compute_model](#wass2s.WAS_PCR.compute_model) | Run the full PCR pipeline on a single train/test split. |
| [compute_prob](#wass2s.WAS_PCR.compute_prob) | Compute tercile probability forecasts from a deterministic hindcast. |
| [forecast](#wass2s.WAS_PCR.forecast) | Generate an operational forecast for a target year. |

### compute_model { #wass2s.WAS_PCR.compute_model }

```python
WAS_PCR.compute_model(X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test=None, **kwargs)
```

Run the full PCR pipeline on a single train/test split.

Performs EOF dimensionality reduction on the predictor, then delegates
to the wrapped regression model.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                         | Description                                                                                                   | Default    |
|----------|----------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| X_train  | xarray.DataArray or list of xarray.DataArray | Training predictor field(s).                                                                                  | _required_ |
| y_train  | xarray.DataArray                             | Training target (predictand).                                                                                 | _required_ |
| X_test   | xarray.DataArray or list of xarray.DataArray | Test predictor field(s).                                                                                      | _required_ |
| y_test   | xarray.DataArray                             | Test target.  Forwarded to the regression model only when its ``compute_model`` signature accepts ``y_test``. | `None`     |
| **kwargs |                                              | Additional keyword arguments forwarded to the regression model.                                               | `{}`       |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                       |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | object | Whatever the wrapped regression model's ``compute_model`` returns (typically a deterministic hindcast DataArray). |

### compute_prob { #wass2s.WAS_PCR.compute_prob }

```python
WAS_PCR.compute_prob(
    Predictant,
    clim_year_start,
    clim_year_end,
    hindcast_det,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Compute tercile probability forecasts from a deterministic hindcast.

Delegates directly to the wrapped regression model's ``compute_prob``
method.  Returns ``None`` if the model does not implement it.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type             | Description                                                     | Default    |
|-----------------|------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| Predictant      | xarray.DataArray | Observed predictand over the full hindcast period.              | _required_ |
| clim_year_start | int              | First year of the climatological reference period.              | _required_ |
| clim_year_end   | int              | Last year of the climatological reference period.               | _required_ |
| hindcast_det    | xarray.DataArray | Deterministic hindcast produced by :meth:`compute_model`.       | _required_ |
| **kwargs        |                  | Additional keyword arguments forwarded to the regression model. | `{}`       |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                     | Description                                                                                                                                 |
|--------|--------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | xarray.DataArray or None | Tercile probabilities (below-normal, near-normal, above-normal), or ``None`` if the regression model does not support probabilistic output. |

### forecast { #wass2s.WAS_PCR.forecast }

```python
WAS_PCR.forecast(
    Predictant,
    clim_year_start,
    clim_year_end,
    Predictor,
    hindcast_det,
    Predictor_for_year,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Generate an operational forecast for a target year.

EOF patterns are fitted on the full hindcast predictor, and the
target-year predictor is projected onto those patterns before being
passed to the regression model.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name               | Type                                         | Description                                                     | Default    |
|--------------------|----------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| Predictant         | xarray.DataArray                             | Observed predictand over the full hindcast period.              | _required_ |
| clim_year_start    | int                                          | First year of the climatological reference period.              | _required_ |
| clim_year_end      | int                                          | Last year of the climatological reference period.               | _required_ |
| Predictor          | xarray.DataArray or list of xarray.DataArray | Full hindcast predictor field(s) used to fit the EOF model.     | _required_ |
| hindcast_det       | xarray.DataArray                             | Deterministic hindcast produced during cross-validation.        | _required_ |
| Predictor_for_year | xarray.DataArray or list of xarray.DataArray | Predictor field(s) for the target forecast year.                | _required_ |
| **kwargs           |                                              | Additional keyword arguments forwarded to the regression model. | `{}`       |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                          |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | object | Operational forecast returned by the wrapped regression model's ``forecast`` method. |
